title: Uniqueness of Stationary Black-Hole Exteriors
exact_target: Determine whether the regular stationary vacuum black-hole exteriors under the report's horizon assumptions are all Kerr.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001360 (OWR-4129-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/46, pp. 2585--2646; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 18--20.
Ionescu--Klainerman, stationary uniqueness; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The catalogue literature assessment calls this a dynamical settling expectation, but the clean statement and primary uniqueness contribution concern stationary uniqueness. The report explains real-analytic uniqueness and seeks weaker regularity. Dynamical Kerr stability is a different target, related to ID 30001359.
